1.zh: 作使徒的保罗（不是由于人，也不是借着人，乃是借着耶稣基督，与叫他从死里复活的父　神）
1.en: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

1.zh: 和一切与我同在的众弟兄，写信给加拉太的各教会。
1.en: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

1.zh: 愿恩惠、平安从父　神与我们的主耶稣基督归与你们！
1.en: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

1.zh: 基督照我们父　神的旨意，为我们的罪舍己，要救我们脱离这罪恶的世代。
1.en: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

1.zh: 但愿荣耀归于　神，直到永永远远。阿们！
1.en: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

1.zh: 我希奇你们这么快离开那借着基督之恩召你们的，去从别的福音。
1.en: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

1.zh: 那并不是[福音]，不过有些人搅扰你们，要把基督的福音更改了。
1.en: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

1.zh: 但无论是我们，是天上来的使者，若传福音给你们，与我们所传给你们的不同，他就应当被咒诅。
1.en: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

1.zh: 我们已经说了，现在又说，若有人传福音给你们，与你们所领受的不同，他就应当被咒诅。
1.en: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

1.zh: 我现在是要得人的心呢？还是要得　神的心呢？我岂是讨人的喜欢吗？若仍旧讨人的喜欢，我就不是基督的仆人了。
1.en: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

1.zh: 弟兄们，我告诉你们，我素来所传的福音不是出于人的意思。
1.en: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

1.zh: 因为我不是从人领受的，也不是人教导我的，乃是从耶稣基督启示来的。
1.en: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 你们听见我从前在犹太教中所行的事，怎样极力逼迫残害　神的教会。
1.en: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

1.zh: 我又在犹太教中，比我本国许多同岁的人更有长进，为我祖宗的遗传更加热心。
1.en: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

1.zh: 然而，那把我从母腹里分别出来、又施恩召我的　神，
1.en: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

1.zh: 既然乐意将他儿子启示在我心里，叫我把他传在外邦人中，我就没有与属血气的人商量，
1.en: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

1.zh: 也没有上耶路撒冷去见那些比我先作使徒的，惟独往阿拉伯去，后又回到大马士革。
1.en: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

1.zh: 过了三年，才上耶路撒冷去见矶法，和他同住了十五天。
1.en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

1.zh: 至于别的使徒，除了主的兄弟雅各，我都没有看见。
1.en: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

1.zh: 我写给你们的不是谎话，这是我在　神面前说的。
1.en: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

1.zh: 以后我到了叙利亚和基利家境内。
1.en: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

1.zh: 那时，犹太信基督的各教会都没有见过我的面。
1.en: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

1.zh: 不过听说那从前逼迫我们的，现在传扬他原先所残害的真道。
1.en: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

1.zh: 他们就为我的缘故，归荣耀给　神。
1.en: So they glorified God in me.

2.zh: 过了十四年，我同巴拿巴又上耶路撒冷去，并带着提多同去。
2.en: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

2.zh: 我是奉启示上去的，把我在外邦人中所传的福音对弟兄们陈说；却是背地里对那有名望之人说的，惟恐我现在，或是从前，徒然奔跑。
2.en: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

2.zh: 但与我同去的提多，虽是希腊人，也没有勉强他受割礼；
2.en: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

2.zh: 因为有偷着引进来的假弟兄，私下窥探我们在基督耶稣里的自由，要叫我们作奴仆。
2.en: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

2.zh: 我们就是一刻的工夫也没有容让顺服他们，为要叫福音的真理仍存在你们中间。
2.en: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

2.zh: 至于那些有名望的，不论他是何等人，都与我无干。　神不以外貌取人。那些有名望的，并没有加增我什么，
2.en: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

2.zh: 反倒看见了主托我传福音给那未受割礼的人，正如托彼得传福音给那受割礼的人。（
2.en: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

2.zh: 那感动彼得、叫他为受割礼之人作使徒的，也感动我，叫我为外邦人作使徒；）
2.en: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

2.zh: 又知道所赐给我的恩典，那称为[教会]柱石的雅各、矶法、约翰，就向我和巴拿巴用右手行相交之礼，叫我们往外邦人那里去，他们往受割礼的人那里去。
2.en: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

2.zh: 只是愿意我们记念穷人；这也是我本来热心去行的。
2.en: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

2.zh: 后来，矶法到了安提阿；因他有可责之处，我就当面抵挡他。
2.en: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

2.zh: 从雅各那里来的人未到以先，他和外邦人一同吃饭，及至他们来到，他因怕奉割礼的人，就退去与外邦人隔开了。
2.en: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

2.zh: 其余的犹太人也都随着他装假，甚至连巴拿巴也随伙装假。
2.en: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

2.zh: 但我一看见他们行的不正，与福音的真理不合，就在众人面前对矶法说：「你既是犹太人，若随外邦人行事，不随犹太人行事，怎么还勉强外邦人随犹太人呢？」
2.en: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

2.zh: 我们这生来的犹太人，不是外邦的罪人；
2.en: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

2.zh: 既知道人称义不是因行律法，乃是因信耶稣基督，连我们也信了基督耶稣，使我们因信基督称义，不因行律法称义；因为凡有血气的，没有一人因行律法称义。
2.en: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

2.zh: 我们若求在基督里称义，却仍旧是罪人，难道基督是叫人犯罪的吗？断乎不是！
2.en: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

2.zh: 我素来所拆毁的，若重新建造，这就证明自己是犯罪的人。
2.en: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

2.zh: 我因律法，就向律法死了，叫我可以向　神活着。
2.en: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

2.zh: 我已经与基督同钉十字架，现在活着的不再是我，乃是基督在我里面活着；并且我如今在肉身活着，是因信　神的儿子而活；他是爱我，为我舍己。
2.en: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

2.zh: 我不废掉　神的恩；义若是借着律法得的，基督就是徒然死了。
2.en: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

3.zh: 无知的加拉太人哪，耶稣基督钉十字架，已经活画在你们眼前，谁又迷惑了你们呢？
3.en: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

3.zh: 我只要问你们这一件：你们受了[圣]灵，是因行律法呢？是因听信[福音]呢？
3.en: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

3.zh: 你们既靠[圣]灵入门，如今还靠肉身成全吗？你们是这样的无知吗？
3.en: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

3.zh: 你们受苦如此之多，都是徒然的吗？难道果真是徒然的吗？
3.en: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

3.zh: 那赐给你们[圣]灵，又在你们中间行异能的，是因你们行律法呢？是因你们听信[福音]呢？
3.en: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

3.zh: 正如「亚伯拉罕信　神，这就算为他的义」。
3.en: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

3.zh: 所以，你们要知道：那以信为本的人，就是亚伯拉罕的子孙。
3.en: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

3.zh: 并且圣经既然预先看明，　神要叫外邦人因信称义，就早已传福音给亚伯拉罕，[说]：「万国都必因你得福。」
3.en: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”

3.zh: 可见那以信为本的人和有信心的亚伯拉罕一同得福。
3.en: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

3.zh: 凡以行律法为本的，都是被咒诅的；因为[经上]记着：「凡不常照律法书上所记一切之事去行的，就被咒诅。」
3.en: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”

3.zh: 没有一个人靠着律法在　神面前称义，这是明显的；因为[经上]说：「义人必因信得生。」
3.en: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

3.zh: 律法原不本乎信，只[说]：「行这些事的，就必因此活着。」
3.en: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

3.zh: 基督既为我们受了咒诅，就赎出我们脱离律法的咒诅；因为[经上]记着：「凡挂在木头上都是被咒诅的。」
3.en: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”

3.zh: 这便叫亚伯拉罕的福，因基督耶稣可以临到外邦人，使我们因信得着所应许的[圣]灵。
3.en: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

3.zh: 弟兄们，我且照着人的常话说：虽然是人的文约，若已经立定了，就没有能废弃或加增的。
3.en: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

3.zh: 所应许的原是向亚伯拉罕和他子孙说的。　神并不是说「众子孙」，指着许多人，乃是说「你那一个子孙」，指着一个人，就是基督。
3.en: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.

3.zh: 我是这么说，　神预先所立的约，不能被那四百三十年以后的律法废掉，叫应许归于虚空。
3.en: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

3.zh: 因为承受产业，若本乎律法，就不本乎应许；但　神是凭着应许把产业赐给亚伯拉罕。
3.en: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

3.zh: 这样说来，律法是为什么有的呢？原是为过犯添上的，等候那蒙应许的子孙来到，并且是借天使经中保之手设立的。
3.en: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

3.zh: 但中保本不是为一面作的；　神却是一位。
3.en: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

3.zh: 这样，律法是与　神的应许反对吗？断乎不是！若曾传一个能叫人得生的律法，义就诚然本乎律法了。
3.en: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

3.zh: 但圣经把众人都圈在罪里，使所应许的[福]因信耶稣基督，归给那信的人。
3.en: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

3.zh: 但这[因]信[得救的理]还未来以先，我们被看守在律法之下，直圈到那将来的真道显明出来。
3.en: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

3.zh: 这样，律法是我们训蒙的师傅，[引我们]到基督那里，使我们因信称义。
3.en: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

3.zh: 但这[因]信[得救的理]既然来到，我们从此就不在师傅的手下了。
3.en: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

3.zh: 所以，你们因信基督耶稣都是　神的儿子。
3.en: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

3.zh: 你们受洗归入基督的都是披戴基督了。
3.en: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

3.zh: 并不分犹太人、希腊人，自主的、为奴的，或男或女，因为你们在基督耶稣里都成为一了。
3.en: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

3.zh: 你们既属乎基督，就是亚伯拉罕的后裔，是照着应许承受产业的了。
3.en: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

4.zh: 我说那承受产业的，虽然是全业的主人，但为孩童的时候却与奴仆毫无分别，
4.en: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

4.zh: 乃在师傅和管家的手下，直等他父亲预定的时候来到。
4.en: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

4.zh: 我们为孩童的时候，受管于世俗小学之下，也是如此。
4.en: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

4.zh: 及至时候满足，　神就差遣他的儿子，为女子所生，且生在律法以下，
4.en: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

4.zh: 要把律法以下的人赎出来，叫我们得着儿子的名分。
4.en: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

4.zh: 你们既为儿子，　神就差他儿子的灵进入你们的心，呼叫：「阿爸！父！」
4.en: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”

4.zh: 可见，从此以后，你不是奴仆，乃是儿子了；既是儿子，就靠着　神为后嗣。
4.en: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

4.zh: 但从前你们不认识　神的时候，是给那些本来不是神的作奴仆；
4.en: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

4.zh: 现在你们既然认识　神，更可说是被　神所认识的，怎么还要归回那懦弱无用的小学，情愿再给他作奴仆呢？
4.en: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

4.zh: 你们谨守日子、月份、节期、年份，
4.en: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

4.zh: 我为你们害怕，惟恐我在你们身上是枉费了工夫。
4.en: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

4.zh: 弟兄们，我劝你们要像我一样，因为我也像你们一样。你们一点没有亏负我。
4.en: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

4.zh: 你们知道我头一次传福音给你们，是因为身体有疾病。
4.en: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

4.zh: 你们为我身体的缘故受试炼，没有轻看我，也没有厌弃我，反倒接待我，如同　神的使者，如同基督耶稣。
4.en: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

4.zh: 你们当日所夸的福气在哪里呢？那时你们若能行，就是把自己的眼睛剜出来给我，也都情愿。这是我可以给你们作见证的。
4.en: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

4.zh: 如今我将真理告诉你们，就成了你们的仇敌吗？
4.en: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

4.zh: 那些人热心待你们，却不是好意，是要离间你们，叫你们热心待他们。
4.en: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

4.zh: 在善事上，常用热心待人原是好的，却不单我与你们同在的时候才这样。
4.en: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

4.zh: 我小子啊，我为你们再受生产之苦，直等到基督成形在你们心里。
4.en: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

4.zh: 我巴不得现今在你们那里，改换口气，因我为你们心里作难。
4.en: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

4.zh: 你们这愿意在律法以下的人，请告诉我，你们岂没有听见律法吗？
4.en: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

4.zh: 因为[律法上]记着，亚伯拉罕有两个儿子，一个是使女生的，一个是自主之妇人生的。
4.en: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

4.zh: 然而，那使女所生的是按着血气生的；那自主之妇人所生的是凭着应许生的。
4.en: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

4.zh: 这都是比方：那两个妇人就是两约。一约是出于西奈山，生子为奴，乃是夏甲。
4.en: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

4.zh: 这夏甲二字是指着阿拉伯的西奈山，与现在的耶路撒冷同类，因耶路撒冷和她的儿女都是为奴的。
4.en: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

4.zh: 但那在上的耶路撒冷是自主的，她是我们的母。
4.en: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

4.zh: 因为[经上]记着： 不怀孕、不生养的，你要欢乐； 未曾经过产难的，你要高声欢呼； 因为没有丈夫的，比有丈夫的儿女更多。
4.en: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”

4.zh: 弟兄们，我们是凭着应许作儿女，如同以撒一样。
4.en: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

4.zh: 当时，那按着血气生的逼迫了那按着[圣]灵生的，现在也是这样。
4.en: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

4.zh: 然而经上是怎么说的呢？[是说]：「把使女和她儿子赶出去！因为使女的儿子不可与自主妇人的儿子一同承受产业。」
4.en: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”

4.zh: 弟兄们，这样看来，我们不是使女的儿女，乃是自主妇人的儿女了。
4.en: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

5.zh: 基督释放了我们，叫我们得以自由。所以要站立得稳，不要再被奴仆的轭挟制。
5.en: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

5.zh: 我—保罗告诉你们，若受割礼，基督就与你们无益了。
5.en: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

5.zh: 我再指着凡受割礼的人确实地说，他是欠着行全律法的债。
5.en: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

5.zh: 你们这要靠律法称义的，是与基督隔绝，从恩典中坠落了。
5.en: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

5.zh: 我们靠着[圣]灵，凭着信心，等候所盼望的义。
5.en: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

5.zh: 原来在基督耶稣里，受割礼不受割礼全无功效，惟独使人生发仁爱的信心才有功效。
5.en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

5.zh: 你们向来跑得好，有谁拦阻你们，叫你们不顺从真理呢？
5.en: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

5.zh: 这样的劝导不是出于那召你们的。
5.en: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

5.zh: 一点面酵能使全团都发起来。
5.en: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

5.zh: 我在主里很信你们必不怀别样的心；但搅扰你们的，无论是谁，必担当他的罪名。
5.en: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

5.zh: 弟兄们，我若仍旧传割礼，为什么还受逼迫呢？若是这样，那十字架讨厌的地方就没有了。
5.en: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

5.zh: 恨不得那搅乱你们的人把自己割绝了。
5.en: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

5.zh: 弟兄们，你们蒙召是要得自由，只是不可将你们的自由当作放纵情欲的机会，总要用爱心互相服事。
5.en: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

5.zh: 因为全律法都包在「爱人如己」这一句话之内了。
5.en: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

5.zh: 你们要谨慎，若相咬相吞，只怕要彼此消灭了。
5.en: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

5.zh: 我说，你们当顺着[圣]灵而行，就不放纵肉体的情欲了。
5.en: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

5.zh: 因为情欲和[圣]灵相争，[圣]灵和情欲相争，这两个是彼此相敌，使你们不能做所愿意做的。
5.en: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

5.zh: 但你们若被[圣]灵引导，就不在律法以下。
5.en: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

5.zh: 情欲的事都是显而易见的，就如奸淫、污秽、邪荡、
5.en: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

5.zh: 拜偶像、邪术、仇恨、争竞、忌恨、恼怒、结党、纷争、异端、
5.en: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

5.zh: 嫉妒、醉酒、荒宴等类。我从前告诉你们，现在又告诉你们，行这样事的人必不能承受　神的国。
5.en: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

5.zh: 圣灵所结的果子，就是仁爱、喜乐、和平、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信实、
5.en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

5.zh: 温柔、节制。这样的事没有律法禁止。
5.en: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

5.zh: 凡属基督耶稣的人，是已经把肉体连肉体的邪情私欲同钉在十字架上了。
5.en: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

5.zh: 我们若是靠[圣]灵得生，就当靠[圣]灵行事。
5.en: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

5.zh: 不要贪图虚名，彼此惹气，互相嫉妒。
5.en: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

6.zh: 弟兄们，若有人偶然被过犯所胜，你们属灵的人就当用温柔的心把他挽回过来；又当自己小心，恐怕也被引诱。
6.en: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

6.zh: 你们各人的重担要互相担当，如此，就完全了基督的律法。
6.en: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

6.zh: 人若无有，自己还以为有，就是自欺了。
6.en: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

6.zh: 各人应当察验自己的行为；这样，他所夸的就专在自己，不在别人了，
6.en: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

6.zh: 因为各人必担当自己的担子。
6.en: For each man will bear his own burden.

6.zh: 在道理上受教的，当把一切需用的供给施教的人。
6.en: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

6.zh: 不要自欺，　神是轻慢不得的。人种的是什么，收的也是什么。
6.en: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

6.zh: 顺着情欲撒种的，必从情欲收败坏；顺着[圣]灵撒种的，必从[圣]灵收永生。
6.en: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

6.zh: 我们行善，不可丧志；若不灰心，到了时候就要收成。
6.en: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

6.zh: 所以，有了机会就当向众人行善，向信徒一家的人更当这样。
6.en: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

6.zh: 请看我亲手写给你们的字是何等的大呢！
6.en: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

6.zh: 凡希图外貌体面的人都勉强你们受割礼，无非是怕自己为基督的十字架受逼迫。
6.en: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

6.zh: 他们那些受割礼的，连自己也不守律法；他们愿意你们受割礼，不过要借着你们的肉体夸口。
6.en: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

6.zh: 但我断不以别的夸口，只夸我们主耶稣基督的十字架；因这十字架，就我而论，世界已经钉在十字架上；就世界而论，我已经钉在十字架上。
6.en: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

6.zh: 受割礼不受割礼都无关紧要，要紧的就是作新造的人。
6.en: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

6.zh: 凡照此理而行的，愿平安、怜悯加给他们，和　神的以色列民。
6.en: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

6.zh: 从今以后，人都不要搅扰我，因为我身上带着耶稣的印记。
6.en: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

6.zh: 弟兄们，愿我主耶稣基督的恩[常]在你们心里。阿们！
6.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
